source: The Gazette of India: Extraordinary, Part II-Sec. 3(i), No. 124, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Notification G.S.R. 202(E) dated 7th March, 2011
_changelog: v1.1: corrected food_expiry citation (was wrongly attributed to Explanation III, which actually attaches to clause (a) not (d)); added unit_sale_price field (Rule 6(11), inserted by 2021/2022 amendment - verified absent from the original 2011 base text, which is why it was missing in v1.0); caveated country_of_origin citation honestly - corroborated by secondary legal sources as amended into Rule 6(1)(a) for imported packages, but exact amending instrument/date not independently confirmed against a primary source.

mandatory_fields.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, and for any imported package the name and address of the importer.

mandatory_fields.display_name: Common or Generic Name of Commodity
mandatory_fields.description: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package; in case of packages with more than one product, the name and quantity of each.
The net quantity, in terms of standard unit of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, l), or by number where sold by count.
The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.

mandatory_fields.display_name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP incl. of all taxes)
mandatory_fields.description: Retail sale price in the format 'MRP Rs. ... / ₹ ... incl. of all taxes' or 'Maximum / Max. retail price Rs. ... / ₹ ... inclusive of all taxes'. Fractions below 50 paise rounded down to preceding rupee; 50-95 paise rounded to nearest 50 paise (Rule 2(m)).

mandatory_fields.display_name: Unit Sale Price (Rs. per standard unit)
mandatory_fields.rule_reference: Rule 6(11) - NOT in the original 2011 text; inserted by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021 (notified 2 Nov 2021), effective 1 Oct 2022 per the 2022 clarifying amendment
mandatory_fields.description: Price per gram (net qty < 1kg) or per kg (net qty > 1kg) for weight; per cm/metre for length; per ml/litre for volume; per unit/number if sold by count. Rounded to nearest 2 decimal places. Not required for combination/group/multi-piece packages under the 2023 clarifying amendment, per project's earlier research.
Name, address, telephone number, and email address (if available) of the person or office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints.

mandatory_fields.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(a), as amended - NOT present in the original 2011 base text (confirmed absent on direct check of the Gazette text). Multiple secondary legal-industry sources describe this as folded into clause (a) for imported packages specifically, but the exact amending instrument/date could not be independently confirmed against a primary source in this pass - verify before relying on this citation in a legal/judge-facing context.
mandatory_fields.description: For imported packages, country of origin, manufacture, or assembly must be declared alongside the importer's name and address.

table_1_numerals_by_weight_or_volume.description: Rule 7(2)(i) Table-I: Minimum height of numeral when net quantity is declared in terms of weight or volume

table_2_numerals_by_pdp_area.description: Rule 7(2)(ii) Table-II: Minimum height of numeral when net quantity is declared in terms of length, area or number - indexed by the PRINCIPAL DISPLAY PANEL'S area in cm2, not by the commodity's net quantity value.

category_exceptions._comment: Capped at 3 categories per project scope - do not expand further

medical_device.exempt_from: All LMPC Rule 6/7 declarations - governed by Medical Devices Rules, 2017 instead

bulk_exempt.condition: Package contains quantity exceeding 25kg or 25L (except cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50kg), or packaged commodity meant for industrial or institutional consumers

food_expiry.source: Rule 6(1)(d), proviso (food articles - defers to food-specific law instead of this sub-rule's date-declaration requirement; PFA Act 1954 as originally cited in the 2011 text, practically superseded by the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 / FSSAI)

missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Section 18/36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
missing.explanation: The package does not bear a legible Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes, violating Rule 6(1)(e).
missing.recommended_action: Recommend physical verification; if absence of retail price is confirmed by officer, notice under Section 36(1) may apply.

review_required.summary: MRP numerals detected with low visual confidence
review_required.explanation: Price digits or currency qualifiers are faint, smudged, or partially obscured (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Physical inspection recommended to verify exact printed retail price before taking enforcement action.

pass.summary: Maximum Retail Price declared with statutory tax qualifier
pass.explanation: Maximum Retail Price detected ({normalized_value}) bearing mandatory 'inclusive of all taxes' stipulation and compliant currency format.

missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Section 18/36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
missing.explanation: The net weight, measure, or numerical count is not declared on the package in standard SI metric units.
missing.recommended_action: Recommend physical package weight verification; if non-declaration is confirmed, advisory or notice under Section 36(1) may apply.

review_required.summary: Net Quantity detected with low visual confidence
review_required.explanation: Net quantity numerals or unit symbols could not be recognized with high confidence (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Officer manual verification recommended to confirm standard metric quantity on physical container.

pass.summary: Net Quantity declared in standard SI metric units
pass.explanation: Net quantity detected ({normalized_value}) declared using standard metric units of weight, volume, or numerical count conforming to Rule 6(1)(c) and Rule 13.

missing.summary: Month & Year of manufacture / packing absent
missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Section 18/36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
missing.explanation: The package fails to state the month and year of manufacture, pre-packing, or import as required under Rule 6(1)(d).
missing.recommended_action: Recommend physical inspection of container stamps; if manufacturing/packing date is confirmed absent, notice under Section 36(1) may apply.

review_required.summary: Manufacturing date stamp ambiguous or low confidence
review_required.explanation: Date stamp appears faint or dot-matrix dots are partially illegible (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend examining physical batch printing under adequate lighting to confirm legible month and year.

pass.summary: Month and Year of manufacture / packing declared
pass.explanation: Month and year of manufacture/packing detected ({normalized_value}) conforming to Rule 6(1)(d).

missing.summary: Best before / Expiry date declaration absent on perishable article
missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) proviso of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with relevant food safety standards
missing.explanation: Perishable or food package lacks a mandatory 'Best before' or 'Use by' date required under Rule 6(1)(d) proviso.
missing.recommended_action: Recommend physical container check; if commodity is perishable and date is confirmed absent, statutory notice under Section 36(1) may apply.

review_required.summary: Expiry / Best before date stamp detected with low visual confidence
review_required.explanation: Best before / expiry date digits or batch ink impressions appear faint or smudged (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend manual inspection under direct lighting to verify legibility of use-by date on container.

pass.summary: Best before / Expiry date declared on perishable commodity
pass.explanation: Freshness / use-by date declaration identified ({normalized_value}) satisfying Rule 6(1)(d) proviso consumer safety disclosure.

missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 10 of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Section 18/36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
missing.explanation: The package lacks the name and complete physical address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer required for origin traceability.
missing.recommended_action: Recommend officer inspect entire package for complete postal address; if manufacturer cannot be identified, inquiry under Section 36 may be initiated.

review_required.explanation: Producer name or address text was detected with marginal OCR confidence (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend officer manual check to ensure complete postal address and PIN code are present on packaging.

pass.summary: Manufacturer / Packer identity and complete address declared
pass.explanation: Name and complete physical address details detected ({normalized_value}) providing full producer traceability under Rule 6(1)(a) and Rule 10.

missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(2) of LMPC Rules, 2011 read with Section 18/36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
missing.explanation: The package does not provide mandatory contact details (telephone, physical address, or email) for consumer grievance redressal.
missing.recommended_action: Recommend physical check for grievance contact details; if absent, notice under Rule 6(2) read with Section 36(1) may apply.

review_required.summary: Consumer Care details detected with low visual confidence
review_required.explanation: Contact details (helpline or email) were detected with low confidence (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend physical verification of package to ensure functional consumer helpline number or email address is clearly legible.

pass.summary: Consumer Care grievance redressal contact declared
pass.explanation: Direct consumer grievance contact details detected ({normalized_value}) fulfilling mandatory redressal requirements under Rule 6(2).

missing.summary: Unit Sale Price (USP) absent on package
missing.legal_reference: Rule 6(11) of LMPC Rules, 2011 (inserted by 2021/2022 Amendment)
missing.explanation: Package requires declaration of price per standard unit (e.g. Rs./g or Rs./ml) alongside MRP, but none was detected.
missing.recommended_action: Recommend verifying whether package qualifies for multi-pack or equal-price exemptions; if non-exempt, compliance advisory under Rule 6(11) may apply.

review_required.summary: Unit Sale Price detected with low visual confidence
review_required.explanation: Unit sale price digits or unit qualifier are ambiguous (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend physical inspection to verify that unit sale price corresponds correctly to declared retail price and net quantity.

pass.summary: Unit Sale Price declared alongside retail price
pass.explanation: Unit sale price detected ({normalized_value}) per standard metric unit, satisfying price transparency requirements under Rule 6(11).

missing.summary: Common or Generic commodity name absent
missing.explanation: The generic identity of the commodity is omitted from the package, impairing consumer awareness.
missing.recommended_action: Recommend verifying whether generic identity is declared elsewhere on package; if omitted, advisory under Rule 6(1)(b) may apply.

review_required.explanation: Generic product identity detected with low confidence (confidence: {confidence:.2f}).
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend physical verification to confirm generic commodity name is plainly visible to consumers.

pass.summary: Common or Generic commodity name declared
pass.explanation: Clear generic identity of the commodity declared as {normalized_value}, meeting consumer awareness requirements under Rule 6(1)(b).

missing.summary: Country of Origin declaration not detected
missing.legal_reference: Amended country-of-origin labeling requirements (under Rule 6(1)(a) proviso for imported packages; secondary legal source citation - pending primary Gazette confirmation)
missing.explanation: Package does not disclose country of manufacture or assembly (mandatory for imported commodities alongside importer details).
missing.recommended_action: Recommend verifying bill of entry or import documents; if package is imported and origin declaration is omitted, compliance clarification under origin rules may apply.

review_required.summary: Country of Origin declaration detected with low confidence
review_required.explanation: Country of origin wording detected with low confidence (confidence: {confidence:.2f}); manual confirmation advised.
review_required.recommended_action: Recommend inspecting package import labeling or documentation to verify declared country of manufacture.

pass.summary: Country of Origin declared on package
pass.explanation: Country of manufacture or assembly identified as {normalized_value} satisfying origin transparency requirements for imported packaging.

fail_below_threshold.summary: Numeral font height below statutory minimum threshold
fail_below_threshold.legal_reference: Rule 7 Table-I / Table-II read with Rule 32(2) of LMPC Rules, 2011
fail_below_threshold.explanation: Character height of '{field_name}' ({measured_height_mm:.1f} mm) is below statutory minimum ({required_height_mm:.1f} mm) prescribed under Rule 7.
fail_below_threshold.recommended_action: Recommend physical verification using digital calipers; if numeral height is confirmed below statutory threshold, penalty provisions under Rule 32(2) may apply.

review_required_calibration.summary: Font height calibration confidence below review threshold
review_required_calibration.explanation: Scale calibration could not be verified with high confidence (confidence: {confidence:.2f}); font height cannot be legally certified from image alone.
review_required_calibration.recommended_action: Officer manual measurement recommended with calibrated digital calipers before making a legal determination.

pass.summary: Numeral and letter font heights meet statutory minimum
pass.explanation: Measured font height for '{field_name}' ({measured_height_mm:.1f} mm) meets or exceeds statutory threshold ({required_height_mm:.1f} mm) prescribed under Rule 7.

fail_outside_pdp.summary: Mandatory declaration located outside Principal Display Panel
fail_outside_pdp.legal_reference: Rule 6 and Rule 8 of LMPC Rules, 2011
fail_outside_pdp.explanation: Declaration '{field_name}' appears on a secondary face rather than consolidated on the designated Principal Display Panel.
fail_outside_pdp.recommended_action: Recommend physical inspection of all package panels; if principal panel omits declarations, advisory under Rule 6 and Rule 8 may apply.

pass.summary: Declaration properly positioned on Principal Display Panel
pass.legal_reference: Rule 6 and Rule 8 of LMPC Rules, 2011
pass.explanation: Declaration '{field_name}' is positioned within the Principal Display Panel (PDP) ensuring prominent legibility under Rule 6 and Rule 8.

review_required.summary: Placement confidence below threshold — physical panel inspection required
review_required.legal_reference: Rule 6 and Rule 8 of LMPC Rules, 2011
review_required.explanation: Declaration '{field_name}' placement detection confidence ({confidence:.2f}) is below the statutory 0.75 threshold; physical verification required.
review_required.recommended_action: Verify package orientation and confirm declaration legibility on the physical principal display panel.

medical_device.summary: Exempt from LMPC declarations under 2025 Amendment
medical_device.explanation: Exempt from LMPC Rule 6 & 7 declarations; governed under Medical Devices Rules, 2017.

bulk_exempt.summary: Exempt as bulk/wholesale or institutional package
bulk_exempt.explanation: Exempt from retail declarations under Rule 3: package quantity exceeds 25 kg/L or is packaged exclusively for institutional/industrial consumers.
